blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Bureau of Customs (BOC) will conduct a public auction of 11 luxury vehicles in Manila on Oct. 30, aiming to generate some P226 million in revenues. “The Bureau of Customs, through the Port of Manila (POM), invites interested bidders to participate in a public auction through sealed bidding featuring eleven (11) luxury vehicles, including a 2022 Ferrari SF90 Stradale and a 2021 McLaren Senna,” the BOC said in a social media post Monday. The other vehicles that are up for auction are a Lexus ES (2019), a Toyota Alphard (2019), a Land Rover Range Rover (2021), a […]...
